note: Google Ads Editor CSV import, read on Google's own help pages on the date above. Headers are matched in English and ignore capitals and spaces. Each row is one item: a campaign, an ad group, a keyword or an ad. A blank cell means no change.

values.networksNote: Networks takes Google Search; Search Partners; Search; Display or Select, separated by semicolons. Search turns on both Google Search and Search Partners, so we use Google Search only.
values.languagesNote: Language codes on the campaign row, separated by semicolons.
values.matchTypesNote: Broad is the default when no match type is given.
values.budgetRule: The daily budget must be greater than zero.
values.locationRule: Each location goes on its own row; we leave locations for you to add in Editor.

importSteps: Open Google Ads Editor and download your account (or select it).
Select Account > Import, then From file, and pick the CSV.
Review the column headers. If one is wrong, pick the right header from its drop-down.
Select Import, then Review imported changes. The changes show as proposed changes in your account.
Keep the changes, add your location (below), then post the changes to your account.
budget: Google treats the daily budget as an average: on some days it can spend up to twice the daily amount and on others less, but never more than 30.4 times the daily budget in a month.
